snippets.snippet_text: "Although we display your products in one of the many currencies we offer, ultimately we charge your customers the equivalent cost in USD. We do this using real-time, mid-market exchange rates to convert purchases to USD for processing. We do not charge any additional fees for this conversion."

"Payouts are always made in USD. If you set up bank payouts, you can select a payout currency (we recommend this matches your bank account). If you select a currency other than USD, our payout processor will convert the payout amount to your selected currency using the mid-market exchange rate at the time of payout."
